compiled_state.title: Document merge.strategy and enforcement.strategy config keys; update dso-config.conf
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: merge.strategy (direct|pr, default direct) and enforcement.strategy (local|ci|both, default local) config keys are readable via read-config.sh
- DD8: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents merge.strategy and enforcement.strategy keys with defaults, valid values, and behavior descriptions

## TDD Requirement
TDD Exemption: criterion #3 — static assets only (Markdown documentation + config file, no conditional logic, no executable assertion possible). The config change is verified by grep, not behavioral assertion.

## Implementation Steps
1. Edit `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`:
   - Add `### merge.strategy` section under the Merge-to-main heading (or create it):
     - Valid values: `direct | pr`
     - Default: `direct`
     - Behavior: when `direct`, merge-to-main.sh runs the direct merge flow; when `pr`, merge-to-main.sh creates a PR and triggers CI
     - Used by: `.claude/scripts/dso merge-to-main.sh` (dispatcher)
   - Add `### enforcement.strategy` section:
     - Valid values: `local | ci | both`
     - Default: `local`
     - Behavior: `local` runs enforcement hooks on local commits; `ci` skips local enforcement hooks (CI-only); `both` runs on both
     - Used by: `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh`
2. Edit `.claude/dso-config.conf`:
   - Add `merge.strategy=pr` (this project uses PR-mode)
   - Add `enforcement.strategy=local`
   - Add explanatory comments above each key matching the CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md format

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] merge.strategy key section exists in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with valid values direct|pr and default direct
  Verify: grep -q 'merge\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md && grep -A5 'merge\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | grep -q 'direct'
- [ ] enforcement.strategy key section exists in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with valid values local|ci|both and default local
  Verify: grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] merge.strategy=pr present in .claude/dso-config.conf
  Verify: grep -q '^merge\.strategy=pr' .claude/dso-config.conf
- [ ] enforcement.strategy=local present in .claude/dso-config.conf
  Verify: grep -q '^enforcement\.strategy=local' .claude/dso-config.conf

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body:
AC amendment: enforcement.strategy scope clarification

enforcement.strategy is consumed by plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh (implemented in story 5177-ec04). CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md must make this clear: document which hooks read enforcement.strategy (pre-commit-review-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-gate.sh, pre-commit-test-quality-gate.sh). Add AC: 'grep -q enforcement.strategy plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md' AND reference to enforcement-gate.sh as the consumer.
